# Notion — Notion for Startups

Free months of the Notion Business plan with Notion AI included: 6 months for startups affiliated with select Notion partners, 3 months for those with a business website and company domain email, or 1 month for under-10-employee companies or incomplete applications.

| **Type** | free plan |
| **Amount** | The vendor publishes no figure |
| **Duration** | 6 months |

### Tiers

Each tier has its own eligibility. A headline figure is usually the top tier, not
what a typical applicant receives.

| Tier | Amount | The vendor's wording | Gate |
|---|---|---|---|
| 6 months free with Notion AI included | — | For non-paying Notion customers with under 100 employees and are affiliated with one of our select startup partners. | A partner code is required |
| 3 months free with Notion AI included | — | For non-paying Notion customers with under 100 employees, a valid business website, and a company domain email address. | No partner needed |
| 1 month free with Notion AI included | — | For non-paying Notion customers with under 10 employees (SMBs) or startups who provided incomplete business information during application. | No partner needed |

### Not covered

- Existing paying Notion customers
- Companies that have received a previous Notion promotion
- Personal email addresses such as Gmail or Outlook

> **Stacking:** The page states applicants must "have not received any previous Notion promotions".

### Notes

Base eligibility is stated as a non-paying Notion customer with a valid work email (no Gmail, Outlook, etc), no previous Notion promotions, and fewer than 100 employees. A dollar value of "$12,000 for 100 employees" was referenced in the page rendering alongside a "$20 per member paid annually" list price, but I could not isolate a clean verbatim span for it, so no amount is published here. The list of "select startup partners" that unlocks the 6-month tier is not enumerated on the page, and the application form itself (app.notion.com) was not opened. Page also states: "The startup offer is equivalent to a maximum of $12,000 for 100 employees." Eligibility quoted verbatim: "You must be a non-paying Notion customer with a valid work email (no Gmail, Outlook, etc), have not received any previous Notion promotions, and have fewer than 100 employees." A partner affiliation extends the offer to 6 months. Page also states: "The startup offer is equivalent to a maximum of $12,000 for 100 employees."
